$comment: Frozen names crossing the Rust/webview seam (design sections 3 and 6). NOT wired into any build. windows-client/tools/contract-check.mjs (T-008) embeds its own copy of these lists as a top-of-file const and checks both sides against it; this file is the reference the Reviewer diffs that const against. No compiler on this machine can catch a rename here, which is the whole reason the list exists.

tauriCommands.name: config_get
tauriCommands.returns: { exists: boolean, path: string, config: RedactedConfig | null, raw: RawConfig | null }
tauriCommands.note: raw omits ingestToken and carries tokenSet instead. Missing file is exists:false, not an error.

tauriCommands.name: config_set
tauriCommands.returns: { ok: true, path: string } | { ok: false, message: string }
tauriCommands.note: Shallow-merges patch over the on-disk object, writes atomically (temp file + rename in the same directory), then sends the `config` control line to the sidecar. Performs no semantic validation - the sidecar is the authority and reports app.error-config.

tauriCommands.name: config_path
tauriCommands.note: The resolved path, for display on the STATUS/MENU page.

tauriCommands.name: uplink_start
tauriCommands.note: Spawns the sidecar if it is not running, then sends the `start` control line.

tauriCommands.name: uplink_stop
tauriCommands.note: Sends the `stop` control line. The child stays alive.

tauriCommands.name: sidecar_restart
tauriCommands.note: Shutdown then respawn. Resets the restart budget.

tauriCommands.name: status_get
tauriCommands.note: The last status the supervisor saw, so a reloaded webview paints immediately instead of waiting for the next event.

tauriEvents.name: sidecar:status
tauriEvents.note: Forwarded verbatim from the sidecar's stdout, or synthesised by the supervisor for app.crashed / app.restarting.

tauriEvents.name: sidecar:log
tauriEvents.note: Sidecar `log` messages plus supervisor-level lines (spawn, exit, decode failure).

tauriEvents.name: sidecar:exit
tauriEvents.payload: { code: number | null, signal: string | null, restarting: boolean, restartsRemaining: number }

bridgeMethods.name: isStub
bridgeMethods.note: boolean property: true when no Tauri bridge was found and the stub is in use.
